entries.subject: ESA/Webb weic2211a
entries.finding: Cartwheel Galaxy (NIRCam and MIRI Composite Image): Webb NIRCam and MIRI, from 0.9 to 18 µm: near-infrared blue to yellow, mid-infrared orange and red; 4685 × 4312 px over 2.34 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.03000 arcsec per pixel, north 28.0° left of vertical, the frame's centre at 9.4234792°, -33.7132367°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
